results.name: Gaza Cybergang | Unified Front Targeting Hamas Opposition - SentinelOne
results.description: Active since at least 2012, Gaza Cybergang is a suspected Hamas-aligned cluster whose operations are primarily targeting Palestinian entities and Israel, focusing on intelligence collection and espionage. Being a threat actor of interest in the context of the Israel-Hamas war, we track Gaza Cybergang as a group composed of several adjacent sub-groups observed to share victims, TTPs, and use related malware strains since 2018. These include Gaza Cybergang Group 1 (Molerats),  Gaza Cybergang Group 2 (Arid Viper, Desert Falcons, APT-C-23), and Gaza Cybergang Group 3 (the group behind Operation Parliament).

results.name: Arid Viper Hacking Group Using Upgraded Malware in Middle East Cyber Attacks
results.description:
The threat actor known as Arid Viper has been observed using refreshed variants of its malware toolkit in its attacks targeting Palestinian entities since September 2022.

Symantec, which is tracking the group under its insect-themed moniker Mantis, said the adversary is "going to great lengths to maintain a persistent presence on targeted networks."

Also known by the names APT-C-23 and Desert Falcon, the hacking group has been linked to attacks aimed at Palestine and the Middle East at least since 2014.

Mantis has used an arsenal of homemade malware tools such as ViperRat, FrozenCell (aka VolatileVenom), and Micropsia to execute and conceal its campaigns across Windows, Android, and iOS platforms.

results.name: Mantis: New Tooling Used in Attacks Against Palestinian Targets
results.description: The Mantis cyber-espionage group(aka Arid Viper, Desert Falcon, APT-C-23), is continuing to mount attacks, deploying a refreshed toolset and going to great lengths to maintain a persistent presence on targeted networks.

results.name: Analysis of the latest attack activities of the APT-C-23 (Twin-Tailed Scorpion) organization
results.description: The APT-C-23 (Twin-Tailed Scorpion) organization is a network attack organization that conducts cyber espionage activities against important areas such as educational institutions and military institutions in the Palestine-Israel region, and mainly steals sensitive information. Attack platforms mainly include Windows and Android. The organization's attacks can be traced back to 2016. In recent years, the organization's activities have been frequently tracked and disclosed by several domestic and foreign security teams.

results.name: Attacks in the Palestinian-Israeli region surrounding the World Cup in Qatar
results.description: In 2018, the APT-C-23 organization carried out cyber attacks by disguising attack samples as World Cup live streaming apps, and this year the 360 Beacon Labs also found attack samples disguised as World Cup-related apps to launch attacks against Arabic users, and as of now (December 9, 2022).  It was discovered that more than 1,000 devices have been infected, mainly in Israel and Palestine.

results.name: Suspected APT-C-23 (two-tailed scorpion) tissue camouflage Threema communication software attack analysis
results.description: APT-C-23 (two-tailed scorpion) is also known as AridViper, Micropsia, FrozenCell, Desert Falcon, and its attack range is mainly in important fields such as educational institutions and military institutions in relevant countries in the Middle East, and important fields such as educational institutions and military institutions in Palestine, a network attack organization that mainly steals sensitive information. It has the ability to attack both Windows and Android platforms. From May 2016, organized, planned and targeted long-term uninterrupted attacks were launched on Palestinian educational institutions, military institutions and other important areas.

results.name: Legal Services Sector Cyber Threat Intel - Key Insights (April 2022)
results.description:
In April, an APT group supported by China was associated with a long-running espionage campaign. The group was tracked as Cicada and known for specifically targeting Japanese entities. The group had targeted the legal services sector as well.

Other Incidents
APT-C-23 group was found catfishing high-ranking Israeli officials working in defense, law, enforcement, and government agencies, to deploy malware. A new wave of phishing attacks delivering the 'more_eggs' malware was observed. The attacks targeted multiple entities including a law firm. Multiple variants of BlackByte ransomware were observed. These variants were written in Go, DotNET, and one variant was found to be written with a mix of Go and C languages. For initial access, the attackers were exploring ProxyShell vulnerabilities in Exchange Server. It was observed targeting entities in the U.S., Australia, Europe, South America, Africa, Asia, and Canada.

results.name: Operation Bearded Barbie: APT-C-23 Campaign Targeting Israeli Officials
results.description: Over the last several years, the Cybereason Nocturnus Team has been tracking different APT groups operating in the Middle East region, including two main sub-groups of the Hamas cyberwarfare division: Molerats and APT-C-23. Both groups are Arabic-speaking and politically-motivated that operate on behalf of Hamas, the Palestinian Islamic-fundamentalist movement and a terrorist organization that has controlled the Gaza strip since 2006.

results.name: Operation Bearded Barbie: APT-C-23 Campaign Targeting Israeli Officials
results.description: Cybereason Nocturnus has discovered a new espionage campaign targeting high-profile Israeli individuals and officials working for sensitive military and emergency services organizations.  the group believed to be working on behalf of Hamas.

results.name: Arid Gopher Malware Targets Computers Running Microsoft Windows to Infiltrate Important Assets
results.description:
Researchers found a Go-written variant of the malware in 2017 named it Arid Gopher. It is used exclusively by Arid Viper (aka APT-C-23), an APT group believed to be based in Gaza.

'helper' and second-stage malware
This new variant is still being developed; all three files share a common baseline, but each file contains unique code which is not present in the other files. Besides the main implant, a 'helper' malware, and a second-stage malware that was downloaded from the C2 server were also written in Go.

results.name: Additional APT-C-23 IOCs - September 2021
Phenakite iOS malware
results.description:
Facebook has recently published a technical paper regarding a threat actor named APT-C-23.

Almost half of their report is about a new iOS malware that is in use by the threat actor.

Facebook called this malware Phenakite and provided 2 hashes of malware samples, however, those samples are not publicly available (yet).

results.name: APT-C-23 Threat Group Uses Voice Changing Software in Espionage Attempt
results.description: Today Cado Security is releasing a report detailing the activities of a Middle Eastern cyber espionage group, APT-C-23, that performs surveillance on their political opponents. To execute this operation, the group employs well known social engineering methods. One is to send spear phishing emails with topics of interests to the targets.
